race.comment: ELASTANE MISS (2) resumes and is a model of consistency for the Carroll yard, having placed twice at here in stronger mares' benchmark races before the break. Is yet to miss the frame over this track and trip from four attempts and gets a key booking in Heywood. Is sure to be right there again. LUJAEGO (7) is a danger first-up and is sure to be hunting the front. Does have to go up a couple of rungs from her last sighting but she's still lightly raced and open to improvement. WINTER HAIL (1) is race-fit and consistent, coming through a Corowa CL2 second and a Gundagai placing at short odds. Doesn't have to improve much here to be fighting out the finish and Boudvillain sticking is big bonus. FLYING CORSAIR (4) has upside after winning his maiden at Albury. Deserves following up. IROQUAI (9) will be hoping the pace is genuine so she can launch late.
